coachView.name: ProgressBar
coachView.layout:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><ns2:layout xmlns:ns2="http://www.ibm.com/bpm/CoachDesignerNG" xmlns:ns3="http://www.ibm.com/bpm/coachview"><ns2:layoutItem xsi:type="ns2:CustomHTML" version="8550" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"><ns2:id>b2de71bb-aa13-47e9-887c-69eff3abd96c</ns2:id><ns2:layoutItemId>CustomHTML1</ns2:layoutItemId><ns2:configData><ns2:id>2516d1ee-860e-4abd-9811-672a85846fdc</ns2:id><ns2:optionName>@customHTML.contentType</ns2:optionName><ns2:value>TEXT</ns2:value></ns2:configData><ns2:configData><ns2:id>040f08d1-e209-4cda-bccb-bc91a4b3207b</ns2:id><ns2:optionName>@customHTML.textContent</ns2:optionName><ns2:value><div class="progressbar_maincontentbox" role="region" aria-label="Progress indicator">
  <div class="progressbar-container">
    <!-- Progress bar track -->
    <div class="progressbar-track" role="progressbar" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow="0">
      <div class="progressbar-fill"></div>
    </div>
    
    <!-- Percentage display -->
    <div class="progressbar-percentage" aria-live="polite">
      <span class="percentage-value">0%</span>
    </div>
    
    <!-- Status message -->
    <div class="progressbar-status" aria-live="polite">
      <span class="status-message">Not started</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</div></ns2:value></ns2:configData></ns2:layoutItem></ns2:layout>
coachView.description: Animated horizontal progress bar with color-coded states and real-time percentage display for IBM Business Automation Workflow

configOption.name: showPercentage
configOption.label: Show Percentage
configOption.description: Display the percentage value above the progress bar

configOption.name: showStatus
configOption.label: Show Status
configOption.description: Display status message below the progress bar

configOption.name: animated
configOption.label: Animated
configOption.description: Enable smooth transition animations for progress changes

configOption.name: customMessages
configOption.label: Custom Messages
configOption.description: Custom status messages (object with notStarted, inProgress, complete properties)

configOption.name: progressChanged
configOption.label: Progress Changed
configOption.description: Event fired when progress value changes
